events.description_en: The Act commences. CBK and CMA become the licensing authorities; carrying on virtual-asset business in or from Kenya without a licence is an offence (s. 8).

events.regulator: Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) · Capital Markets Authority (CMA)
events.regime: Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act No. 20 of 2025)
events.description_en: CBK and CMA public notice: licensing will start once the National Treasury issues Regulations; no VASP has been licensed under the Act.

events.regulator: Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) · Capital Markets Authority (CMA)
events.regime: Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act No. 20 of 2025)
events.description_en: The Virtual Asset Service Providers Regulations, 2026 (Legal Notice 134 of 2026) are published in the Kenya Gazette and commence the same day. They set out licence applications, capital, governance, consumer-protection, stablecoin and tokenisation rules; the regulator must decide a complete application within 30 days (reg. 6(4)).

events.regulator: Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) · Capital Markets Authority (CMA)
events.regime: Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act No. 20 of 2025)
events.description_en: Section 47 gives anyone already providing virtual-asset services one year from commencement to comply with the Act. One year from 4 November 2025 is 4 November 2026 (VASP Tracker calculation).

events.regulator: OCC · Federal Reserve · FDIC · NCUA · state regulators · Treasury
events.description_en: The GENIUS Act is enacted (Public Law 119-27).

events.regulator: OCC · Federal Reserve · FDIC · NCUA · state regulators · Treasury
events.description_en: Treasury publishes an interim final rule on the review of state certifications. The notice states that the Act's effective date is expected to be 18 January 2027.

events.regulator: OCC · Federal Reserve · FDIC · NCUA · state regulators · Treasury
events.description_en: Expected effective date. Section 20 makes the Act effective on the earlier of 18 months after enactment or 120 days after the primary federal regulators issue final implementing rules. Treasury gives 18 January 2027 as the expected date.
The FCA application window opens at 9:00. Firms apply for authorisation, or for a variation of permission, through FCA Connect.
The application window closes at 23:59. Existing firms that apply within the window can keep operating while their application is assessed, if no decision has been made before the regime starts.
Full commencement: cryptoasset activities become FCA-regulated activities and require authorisation.
Parliament passes the Digital Assets Framework Act.
Royal Assent.

The Act commences. Digital asset platforms (DAPs) and tokenised custody platforms (TCPs) come under the financial services licensing regime. On ASIC's roadmap, operators can lodge licence applications in months 12–18 and operate under regulatory relief while those applications are processed.

events.regime: Federal Law No. 282-FZ on Digital Currencies and Digital Rights (2026)

events.regime: Federal Law No. 282-FZ on Digital Currencies and Digital Rights (2026)

events.regime: Act amending the FIEA and the Payment Services Act (Act No. 64 of 2026)

events.regime: Act amending the FIEA and the Payment Services Act (Act No. 64 of 2026)
events.description_en: First provisions take effect 20 days after promulgation: higher penalties for unregistered business and new criminal-investigation powers for the SESC.

events.regime: Act amending the FIEA and the Payment Services Act (Act No. 64 of 2026)
events.description_en: Latest date for the main provisions. The Act takes effect on 'a date set by Cabinet Order within one year of promulgation' (Supplementary Provisions, art. 1). Promulgation was 23 July 2026, derived from the FSA's 20-day count, so the latest date is 22 July 2027 by our calculation. The Cabinet Order date has not been announced.
The Stablecoin Act receives Royal Assent, enacted by section 600 of the 2026 budget implementation statute (S.C. 2026, c. 3).

events.regulator: Bank of Ghana (BoG) · Securities and Exchange Commission
events.description_en: Parliament passes the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act 1154), Under the Act, the Bank of Ghana works with the SEC and the Financial Intelligence Centre to register and license VASPs.
Stablecoin issuer regime takes effect: issuing fiat-referenced stablecoins becomes a regulated activity that needs an HKMA licence.
FSTB and SFC conclude consultations on licensing virtual-asset dealers and custodians and plan to introduce a bill into the Legislative Council in 2026.
HKMA grants the first two stablecoin issuer licences, to Anchorpoint Financial Limited and The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.

events.regime: MiCA applies directly · national act on the crypto-asset market not in force
events.description_en: The MiCA transitional period (Art. 143(3)) ends. Because no implementing act is in force, no Polish authority, including the KNF, has been designated as competent authority, so CASP authorisations cannot be obtained in Poland.

events.regime: MiCA applies directly · national act on the crypto-asset market not in force
events.description_en: The Sejm fails to override the veto: 241 for, 198 against, 3 abstentions, short of the 3/5 majority required.

events.regime: FinIA amendment: payment instrument institutions and crypto institutions (draft)

events.description_en: SPK decision 18/617 extends two deadlines: providers on the 'operating list' to obtain authorisation, and platforms to sign and file custody agreements. The new deadline will be set after SPK-authorised custodians begin providing custody to platforms widely.

events.description_en: The NSSMC reports that the virtual assets bill, which passed first reading in September 2025, makes the NSSMC the main crypto-market regulator and the National Bank of Ukraine the supervisor of e-money tokens. The chair expects the new law to apply from 2027.

events.regime: NAPP licensing regulation for crypto-asset service providers (reg. no. 3380, 2022)

events.regime: NAPP licensing regulation for crypto-asset service providers (reg. no. 3380, 2022)
events.description_en: NAPP's register shows crypto-exchange licence CE #0007 issued to COINPAY on 12 October 2026, the most recent crypto-exchange licence listed.

End of the one-year period for persons subject to the law to bring their positions into line (Art. 184). The CBUAE Board may extend it; we found no published general extension (checked 21 Oct 2026).

events.regime: Virtual Assets Act, 2026 · Virtual Asset Services Regulations, 2026

events.regime: Virtual Assets Act, 2026 · Virtual Asset Services Regulations, 2026
events.description_en: The Virtual Asset Services Regulations, 2026 and the Activity Specific Regulations, 2026 are notified in the Gazette and take effect. Licensing runs in steps: a No-Objection Certificate (NOC, valid 3 months), then incorporation in Pakistan, then a licence application decided within 90 days.

events.regime: Virtual Assets Act, 2026 · Virtual Asset Services Regulations, 2026
events.description_en: Deadline for transitional persons to submit an NOC application, or cease operations (s. 70). A complete application lets them continue while it is pending, subject to PVARA's interim directives.

ESMA public statement: unauthorised CASPs must immediately stop onboarding EU clients and wind down in an orderly way.

events.regime: MiCA · Act No. 101/2025 on markets in crypto-assets
events.description_en: From this date, VASPs registered under the AML Act may no longer provide services without a licence from the Central Bank.
The Act on crypto-assets (kryptoeiendelsloven), which implements MiCA in Norway, enters into force.
Finanstilsynet extends the transitional period in § 19 of the Act from 30 December 2025 to 30 June 2026 for providers registered under the AML Act.

events.regime: Crypto assets as financial products · FAIS Act No. 37 of 2002
events.description_en: By the end of its 2025/26 financial year the FSCA had received 533 CASP licence applications: 310 approved, 17 declined, 124 withdrawn. It had opened 81 investigations into suspected unlicensed CASP businesses.
RG 1058/2025 is published in the Boletín Oficial, setting registration, cybersecurity, custody, AML and disclosure obligations for PSAVs.
Deadline for registered PSAVs that are natural persons to file the required information; otherwise their registration is cancelled.
Deadline for registered locally incorporated companies.
Deadline for foreign companies (branch registration or local subsidiary).
All remaining RG 1058 requirements become enforceable for PSAVs already registered.

events.regime: Investments and Securities Act, 2025 · SEC digital asset rules · ARIP
events.description_en: The Investments and Securities Act, 2025 commences. It gives the SEC power to register, regulate and supervise virtual asset service providers and digital asset operators.

events.regime: POJK 27/2024 on trading of digital financial assets including crypto assets (Law 4/2023 P2SK)
events.description_en: POJK 27/2024 is promulgated. Law 4/2023 (P2SK) required supervision of digital financial assets to move from Bappebti to the OJK within 24 months, by 12 January 2025.

events.regime: POJK 27/2024 on trading of digital financial assets including crypto assets (Law 4/2023 P2SK)
events.description_en: POJK 27/2024 takes effect and the OJK becomes regulator and supervisor of crypto-asset trading.

events.regime: Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2024 (Act 12 of 2024)
events.description_en: The VASP Act, 2024 is published in the Official Gazette.

events.regime: Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2024 (Act 12 of 2024)
events.description_en: Deadline for providers operating on 1 September 2024 to apply for a licence; from 1 January 2025, those that had not applied must stop operating.

events.regime: Digital Assets and Registered Exchanges Act, 2024 (DARE 2024)
events.description_en: The Digital Assets and Registered Exchanges Act, 2024 comes into force, replacing DARE 2020 with a broader registration regime for digital asset businesses, including stablecoin and staking rules.

events.regime: Digital Assets and Registered Exchanges Act, 2024 (DARE 2024)
events.description_en: Latest SCB list of registered DARE firms (as at 30 April 2026).

events.regime: Act on the Protection of Virtual Asset Users
events.description_en: The Virtual Asset User Protection Act takes effect: VASPs must safeguard user deposits and assets and monitor and report abnormal trading, under FSC supervision and sanctions.

events.regime: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities (AIFC Rules FR00062 of 2023)
events.description_en: The AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities, approved on 10 September 2023, commence and govern digital asset trading facilities and other digital asset firms in the Astana International Financial Centre.

events.regime: PMLA 2002 · VDA service providers as reporting entities (S.O. 1072(E))
events.description_en: The Finance Ministry's notification S.O. 1072(E) brings virtual digital asset service providers (VDA SPs) under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act as reporting entities. Exchange, transfer, custody and issuer-related services must register with FIU-IND.

events.regime: PMLA 2002 · VDA service providers as reporting entities (S.O. 1072(E))
events.description_en: FIU-IND issues show-cause notices to nine offshore VDA SPs operating without registration and asks for their URLs to be blocked. The obligation is activity-based and does not depend on physical presence in India; 31 VDA SPs had registered by then.
The Virtual Assets Service Providers Act, 2022 comes into force; VASPs must register with the FSC.
Deadline for persons already carrying on VASP business to apply for registration.
The Virtual Assets Act, 2023 becomes operational; the Bank of Namibia is the regulatory authority for VASPs and initial token offerings.

events.regime: Lending, Credit and Finance (Bailiwick of Guernsey) Law, 2022 · VASP licensing
events.description_en: The Lending, Credit and Finance Law, 2022 comes into force. Virtual asset service providers need a GFSC licence.

events.regime: NBG rule on registration and supervision of VASPs (2023)
events.description_en: The NBG approves the rule on registration and regulation of virtual asset service providers.

events.regime: NBG rule on registration and supervision of VASPs (2023)
events.description_en: The registration rule comes into force; VASPs must register with the NBG.

events.regime: Proceeds of Crime (Jersey) Law 1999, Schedule 2 · VASP registration
events.description_en: The Proceeds of Crime (Amendment No. 6) (Jersey) Order 2022 widens the regime from virtual currency exchanges, registered since 2016, to all virtual asset service providers, in line with FATF standards. Businesses operating before 30 January 2023 must register with the JFSC to continue.

events.regime: Proceeds of Crime (Jersey) Law 1999, Schedule 2 · VASP registration
events.description_en: End of the transition period for existing businesses to register as VASPs with the JFSC.

events.regulator: Comisión Nacional de Activos Digitales (CNAD) · Banco Central de Reserva (BCR)
events.regime: Ley de Emisión de Activos Digitales (2023) · Ley Bitcoin
events.description_en: The Legislative Assembly adopts the Digital Assets Issuance Law (Decree 643). It creates the CNAD, which registers digital asset service providers (PSAD).

events.regulator: Comisión Nacional de Activos Digitales (CNAD) · Banco Central de Reserva (BCR)
events.regime: Ley de Emisión de Activos Digitales (2023) · Ley Bitcoin
events.description_en: In force eight days after publication in the Diario Oficial of 24 January 2023 (Art. 47; VASP Tracker calculation).

events.regime: Virtual Asset and Initial Token Offering Services Act 2021 (VAITOS)
events.description_en: The VAITOS Act 2021 is proclaimed and comes into force. Existing VASPs and ITO issuers must apply within 3 months; custodians had 18 months.

events.regulator: National Bank of Serbia (NBS) · Securities Commission
events.regime: Law on Digital Assets (Official Gazette RS 153/2020)
events.description_en: The Law on Digital Assets enters into force (Art. 146).

events.regulator: National Bank of Serbia (NBS) · Securities Commission
events.regime: Law on Digital Assets (Official Gazette RS 153/2020)
events.description_en: The law begins to apply; digital asset service providers need NBS (virtual currencies) or Securities Commission (digital tokens) authorisation.

events.regime: Financial Services (DLT Providers and VAA Providers) Regulations 2020
events.description_en: The Financial Services (DLT Providers and VAA Providers) Regulations 2020 are made under the Financial Services Act 2019. Firms using DLT to store or transmit value for others need a GFSC DLT licence. Last amended March 2026.

Banxico Circular 4/2019 is published: banks and ITFs may use virtual assets only for internal operations, with prior Banxico authorisation; they may not offer exchange, transfer or custody services to clients.
The CBB issues final rules for crypto-asset services and crypto-asset exchanges: licensing, governance, capital, AML/CFT, conduct, reporting and cyber security.

events.regime: Digital Currency and Digital Token Prescription Order 2019 · Recognized Markets (DAX) Guidelines
events.description_en: The Capital Markets and Services (Prescription of Securities) (Digital Currency and Digital Token) Order 2019 comes into force; the SC that offering and trading digital assets will require SC authorisation and compliance with securities laws.

events.regime: Digital Currency and Digital Token Prescription Order 2019 · Recognized Markets (DAX) Guidelines
events.description_en: Latest update (20 July 2026) of the SC list of registered digital asset exchanges.
The Digital Asset Business Act 2018 receives assent.
With the Act in effect, the BMA publishes its licence application requirements: Class F (full), Class M (modified) licences cover exchanges, custodians, payment providers and dealers.

events.regulator: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Thailand · Ministry of Finance
events.regime: Emergency Decree on Digital Asset Businesses B.E. 2561 (2018)
events.description_en: The Emergency Decree on Digital Asset Businesses comes into force. Exchanges, brokers and dealers need a licence from the Minister of Finance on the SEC's recommendation.

events.regulator: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Thailand · Ministry of Finance
events.regime: Emergency Decree on Digital Asset Businesses B.E. 2561 (2018)
events.description_en: Deadline (90 days) for existing operators to apply to the SEC if they wanted to keep operating.
